title: Transduction of a paired word
statement: For finite Boolean words $w$ and $r$, let $F$ be the one-pass bit transduction specified by the transition and output rules that define $fT$, and let $\langle w,r\rangle$ be the encoding formed by doubling each bit of $w$, appending the separator $01$, and then appending $r$. Applying $F$ to this encoding yields the word obtained by replacing each bit $b$ of $w$ by $b1$, followed by $00$ and then $r$.
